gsm_gen_sector_index_update = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = gsm_n_si } } gsm_gen_sector_ring_init = yes }
	change_variable = { which = gsm_n_si value = 1 }
	gsm_clamp_max = { VAR = gsm_n_si MAX = 12 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_12 value = gsm_six12_energy_11 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_11 value = gsm_six12_energy_10 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_10 value = gsm_six12_energy_9 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_9 value = gsm_six12_energy_8 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_8 value = gsm_six12_energy_7 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_7 value = gsm_six12_energy_6 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_6 value = gsm_six12_energy_5 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_5 value = gsm_six12_energy_4 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_4 value = gsm_six12_energy_3 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_3 value = gsm_six12_energy_2 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_2 value = gsm_six12_energy_1 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six12_energy_1 value = gsm_six_energy }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_six1m_energy value = gsm_six_energy }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ssp_energy value > 0 } }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_r value = gsm_t_ssn_energy }
		divide_variable = { which = gsm_t_r value = gsm_t_ssp_energy }
		gsm_clamp_max = { VAR = gsm_t_r MAX = @gsm_index_step_max }
		multiply_variable = { which = gsm_six_energy value = gsm_t_r }
		gsm_clamp = { VAR = gsm_six_energy MIN = 1 MAX = @gsm_index_cap }
	}
	set_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_energy value = gsm_six_energy }
	round_variable_to_closest = { which = gsm_d_six_energy value = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_chg_energy value = gsm_six_energy }
	gsm_div_safe = { VAR = gsm_d_six_chg_energy BY = gsm_six1m_energy }
	change_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_chg_energy value = -1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_chg_energy value = 100 }
	round_variable_to_closest = { which = gsm_d_six_chg_energy value = 0.1 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_ytd_energy value = gsm_six_energy }
	gsm_div_safe = { VAR = gsm_d_six_ytd_energy BY = gsm_sixy_energy }
	change_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_ytd_energy value = -1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = gsm_d_six_ytd_energy value = 100 }

			limit = { any_owned_colony = { gsm_planet_investable = yes NOT = { gsm_gen_wz_ind_restricted_here = yes } is_variable_set = gsm_rv_energy check_variable = { which = gsm_rv_energy value > -1 } } }
			ordered_owned_colony = {
				limit = { gsm_planet_investable = yes NOT = { gsm_gen_wz_ind_restricted_here = yes } is_variable_set = gsm_rv_energy check_variable = { which = gsm_rv_energy value > -1 } }
				position = 0
				order_by = gsm_rv_energy

				prev = { set_variable = { which = gsm_t_hq_ok value = 1 } }

	else_if = {
